lineage_clock_expressions.expression_sql: CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(opportunity.close_date AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1' YEAR AND (opportunity.created_date IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(opportunity.close_date AS DATE) >= CAST(opportunity.created_date AS DATE)) THEN TRY_CAST(opportunity.close_date AS DATE) ELSE NULL END AS close_date
(NOT opportunity.created_date IS NULL AND YEAR(opportunity.created_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(opportunity.created_date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)) AS is_created_this_month
(NOT opportunity.created_date IS NULL AND YEAR(opportunity.created_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND QUARTER(opportunity.created_date) = QUARTER(CURRENT_DATE)) AS is_created_this_quarter
CASE WHEN NOT opportunity.created_date IS NULL THEN CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(opportunity.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS INT) END AS days_since_created
(NOT opportunity.close_date IS NULL AND YEAR(opportunity.close_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(opportunity.close_date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)) AS is_closed_this_month
